nodes.Name: gcWork
nodes.DocComment:
A gcWork provides the interface to produce and consume work for the
garbage collector.

A gcWork can be used on the stack as follows:

	(preemption must be disabled)
	gcw := &getg().m.p.ptr().gcw
	.. call gcw.put() to produce and gcw.tryGet() to consume ..

It's important that any use of gcWork during the mark phase prevent
the garbage collector from transitioning to mark termination since
gcWork may locally hold GC work buffers. This can be done by
disabling preemption (systemstack or acquirem).

Fields.Name: id
Fields.DocComment: same ID as the parent P

nodes.Name: putObj
nodes.DocComment:
putObj enqueues a pointer for the garbage collector to trace.
obj must point to the beginning of a heap object or an oblet.

go:nowritebarrierrec

nodes.Name: putObjFast
nodes.DocComment:
putObjFast does a put and reports whether it can be done quickly
otherwise it returns false and the caller needs to call put.

go:nowritebarrierrec

nodes.Name: putObjBatch
nodes.DocComment:
putObjBatch performs a put on every pointer in obj. See put for
constraints on these pointers.

go:nowritebarrierrec

nodes.Name: tryGetObj
nodes.DocComment:
tryGetObj dequeues a pointer for the garbage collector to trace.

If there are no pointers remaining in this gcWork or in the global
queue, tryGet returns 0.  Note that there may still be pointers in
other gcWork instances or other caches.

go:nowritebarrierrec

nodes.Name: tryGetObjFast
nodes.DocComment:
tryGetObjFast dequeues a pointer for the garbage collector to trace
if one is readily available. Otherwise it returns 0 and
the caller is expected to call tryGet().

go:nowritebarrierrec

nodes.Name: dispose
nodes.DocComment:
dispose returns any cached pointers to the global queue.
The buffers are being put on the full queue so that the
write barriers will not simply reacquire them before the
GC can inspect them. This helps reduce the mutator's
ability to hide pointers during the concurrent mark phase.

go:nowritebarrierrec

nodes.Name: balance
nodes.DocComment:
balance moves some work that's cached in this gcWork back on the
global queue.

go:nowritebarrierrec

nodes.Name: empty
nodes.DocComment:
empty reports whether w has no mark work available.

go:nowritebarrierrec

nodes.Name: getempty
nodes.DocComment:
getempty pops an empty work buffer off the work.empty list,
allocating new buffers if none are available.

go:nowritebarrier

nodes.Name: putempty
nodes.DocComment:
putempty puts a workbuf onto the work.empty list.
Upon entry this goroutine owns b. The lfstack.push relinquishes ownership.

go:nowritebarrier

nodes.Name: putfull
nodes.DocComment:
putfull puts the workbuf on the work.full list for the GC.
putfull accepts partially full buffers so the GC can avoid competing
with the mutators for ownership of partially full buffers.

go:nowritebarrier

nodes.Name: trygetfull
nodes.DocComment:
trygetfull tries to get a full or partially empty workbuffer.
If one is not immediately available return nil.

go:nowritebarrier

nodes.Name: prepareFreeWorkbufs
nodes.DocComment:
prepareFreeWorkbufs moves busy workbuf spans to free list so they
can be freed to the heap. This must only be called when all
workbufs are on the empty list.

nodes.Name: freeSomeWbufs
nodes.DocComment:
freeSomeWbufs frees some workbufs back to the heap and returns
true if it should be called again to free more.
